test.create_query: CREATE TABLE nullable_bulk_right_{fanout} ( k UInt64, n0 UInt64, n1 UInt64, n2 UInt64, n3 UInt64, n4 UInt64, n5 UInt64, n6 UInt64, n7 UInt64, n8 UInt64, n9 UInt64, n10 UInt64, n11 UInt64, n12 UInt64, n13 UInt64, n14 UInt64, n15 UInt64, s0 String, s1 String, s2 String, s3 String, nullable_number Nullable(UInt64), nullable_string Nullable(String) ) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY k
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO nullable_bulk_right_{fanout} SELECT number, number, number + 1, number + 2, number + 3, number + 4, number + 5, number + 6, number + 7, number + 8, number + 9, number + 10, number + 11, number + 12, number + 13, number + 14, number + 15, repeat('x', 32), repeat('y', 32), repeat('z', 32), repeat('w', 32), if(number % 2 = 0, NULL, number), if(number % 2 = 0, NULL, repeat('n', 32)) FROM numbers(intDiv(1048576, {fanout}))
test.query: SELECT r.n0, r.n1, r.n2, r.n3, r.n4, r.n5, r.n6, r.n7, r.n8, r.n9, r.n10, r.n11, r.n12, r.n13, r.n14, r.n15 FROM nullable_bulk_left_{fanout} AS l ANY LEFT JOIN nullable_bulk_right_{fanout} AS r ON l.k = r.k SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1 FORMAT Null
SELECT r.s0, r.s1, r.s2, r.s3 FROM nullable_bulk_left_{fanout} AS l ANY LEFT JOIN nullable_bulk_right_{fanout} AS r ON l.k = r.k SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1 FORMAT Null

SELECT r.n0, r.n1, r.n2, r.n3, r.n4, r.n5, r.n6, r.n7, r.n8, r.n9, r.n10, r.n11, r.n12, r.n13, r.n14, r.n15 FROM nullable_bulk_left_{fanout} AS l ANY LEFT JOIN nullable_bulk_right_{fanout} AS r ON l.k = r.k SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 0 FORMAT Null
SELECT r.nullable_number, r.nullable_string FROM nullable_bulk_left_{fanout} AS l ANY LEFT JOIN nullable_bulk_right_{fanout} AS r ON l.k = r.k SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1 FORMAT Null
